symptom: Replaying `describe` output into a second app: `Created entity: ModA.EntA` then `Error: entity ModA.EntA has no member(s) EntA_EntB; grant only names members of the entity or of an entity it inherits from`, after `check` printed "Check passed!". Seen in the field on `describe module` of EchoConnector and NativeNote
cause: `describe module … with all` called `describeEntity` per entity, which prints the entity's grants inline, and only then the associations — so a grant naming an association it owns came before the `create association`. exec resolves a grant's member list when it writes the grant. `check`'s grant pass resolved members against `g.whole.associations` (the whole script) and skipped script-declared entities altogether, so it accepted the forward reference
insight: An association is a member of its FROM entity but a statement of its own, so any emitter that prints per-entity (grants with the entity) can order a member after its use. Grep for other `whole`-vs-`sc` reads in check passes: resolving against the whole script is exactly what makes check blind to ordering that exec enforces. The grant check keeps skipping a declared entity's attribute list (that would be a second copy of exec's) but an association is checked anyway, because its position is the script's choice. Controls: the new pedapp tests fail on the old code with the reported message (describe replay) and with an empty check report (agreement test). `describe entity` alone still prints its grants inline — concatenating `describe entity` before `describe association` by hand is now caught by `check -p` instead
